notes.title: NEW UPDATE AVAILABLE
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551773/921a7c4e061553d75cffa431c604ae42683df7d2.png"][/img][/p][p]After a long period of work, I am pleased to announce that the new Dead World update is now available. It adds several new features, the most important of which is the continuation of the story [b]"The Lost Wagon"[/b][/p][p]From [b]Milanesa Studio[/b], I hope you like it; more updates will be coming in the future.[/p][list][*][p][b]The first continuation of the story "The Lost Wagon" has been added.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]A new inventory system has been added.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]A compass system has been added.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]The weapon system has been improved.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New achievements have been added.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]The "Brazilian Portuguese" language has been added.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Sincerely, [b]Juan Ignacio Ferreyra[/b]. Have a good week.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551773/d8bc3edef96b05ab7b2e5456530dc39aa383c4ff.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: IMPORTANT INFORMATION
notes.content: [h1]Hi everyone![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551773/6d4ef2fe68a69571e35713c345d57c7154988d5d.png"][/img][/p][h2]After a while, I was finally able to upload a new update for Dead World. I know it took me a while, and I want to tell you why: I had a major project loss due to a disk issue, and that forced me to redo several parts from scratch.[/h2][h2]It was a tough blow, but I didn't want to leave the game hanging. With a lot of effort, I managed to recover a lot of it and also took the opportunity to make some changes to the story of The Lost Wagon and Gino's Journey, which now have a more solid and coherent foundation.[/h2][h2]As for the "A Rogue's Tale" mode, it was also lost, and I have to redo almost everything, so it will be available again in a few days. As soon as I have it ready, I'll upload it with another update.[/h2][h2]Thanks to everyone who continues to support the project, and I hope you understand what happened. I'm developing this game alone, and every step, no matter how small, takes time.[/h2][h2]More improvements and new features are coming soon. Thanks for your patience and for being a part of Dead World![/h2][p][/p][h2]– Juan Ignacio Ferreyra (Milanesa Studio)[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551773/40c8dd8ea272e214371898a1e0c8ea42b462b026.png"][/img][/p]
- Fixed the bug that caused Gino to not appear on the chair in "Gino's Journey"

- The weapon "Carneadora" has been added to "Un Rogue Piola"
- Three new achievements have been added.
- Bug fixes have been made.
- Fixed a bug where enemies wouldn't move in "Un Rogue Piola"

notes.title: Gino's Journey
notes.content:
- Added the story "Gino's Journey"
- New bugs were added to be fixed another day

Story 2: Gino's Journey

Gino is a schnauzer from a settlement in La Payunia, Mendoza, considered the last of his kind. When a female schnauzer is discovered in a remote settlement, Daniel and Manuel decide to embark on a dangerous journey to save the schnauzer breed.
